modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Towns is questionable for Saturday's game against the Trail Blazers due to an illness.
injury.detail: Towns is in danger of missing a game for the first time this season, and a decision on his availability will be made closer to the 7:30 p.m. ET tipoff. Towns is riding an impressive streak of posting a double-double in each game so far in 2026-27, and if he's unable to play, Andre Drummond would be in line to start at center.

injury.shortComment: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: The star point forward is looking to avoid a three-game absence with a bruised left foot. Damian Lillard would do the heavy lifting offensively if Avdija is out, while Jayson Kent would be in line for a third consecutive start.

injury.shortComment: Clayton (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Clayton is dealing with left knee tendinitis. Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher would see more playing time off the bench if Clayton is downgraded to out Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Washington (illness/shoulder) has been downgraded from questionable to doubtful ahead of Saturday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Washington was initially tagged as questionable due to a shoulder injury, but he's now listed on the report as doubtful because of an illness. Assuming he's not cleared to play Saturday, Naji Marshall figures to be the top candidate to enter the Mavericks' starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa (lower leg) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Achiuwa has missed three of the Kings' last four games while recovering from a left lower leg contusion, but there's a chance that the veteran forward is available for Saturday's contest. If he's cleared to play, then Dylan Cardwell would likely see a drop in playing time.
